content.value: Physical damage reduction is Armour / (Armour + 12 x incoming physical damage), capped at 90%. Flat armour penetration is multiplied by increased armour penetration, then subtracted before this formula. Armour is therefore more efficient against many small hits than one huge hit.
Every complete 100 armour also imposes a 3% total movement-speed penalty. Armour Speed Penalty Reduction scales that penalty down. Configured low-armour bonuses can apply below 150 armour.

Dodge chance is Evasion / (Evasion + 8 x incoming damage), capped at 95%. Evasion uses entropy: after a random combat seed, chance accumulates so outcomes are distributed rather than independently rerolled forever. Entropy resets after 6 seconds without a hit. It only applies to entity-sourced attack hits, not fall, drowning, fire, freezing, armour-bypassing, or invulnerability-bypassing damage.

Energy Shield absorbs damage before health. Poison and Bleed bypass it; drowning and starvation also bypass it. Void consumes 2 Shield per 1 point of void damage. After 4 seconds without damage it recharges at 12.5% of maximum per second. Faster Start divides the delay by 1 + its value, while Recharge Rate multiplies the refill speed.

Fire, cold, lightning, and void resistance each reduce their matching damage. Effective resistance is clamped from -100% to 75% after penetration. For positive resistance, penetration scales it down; against negative resistance, penetration pushes it farther negative.

A raised shield blocks attacks from the front and subtracts Block Value x (1 + increased Block Value) from the hit. The base shield contributes 8 Block Value. Damage above the block value continues through. Hits of at least 3 damage wear shield durability.
Resolute Technique prevents both evasion and raised-shield blocking for attacks made by its user. Iron Reflexes prevents evasion by converting that rating into armour.
